text:
Jared (PM): quick sync: we need a crisp GA checklist for Console Observability (dashboards, tracing hooks, cost breakdown, error analytics). customers are pushing for predictable metrics and a clear rollout plan.
Mina (Eng): engineering summary: we can deliver core tracing hooks + per-route cost estimates in 2 sprints if we lock sampling defaults. dashboards gallery + quick-apply another sprint. error RCA links are lightweight if we rely on existing trace ids.
Priya (SRE): ops constraints: require throttles and graceful fallback. suggest default hosted retention 7d, dedicated 30d. need SLOs for dashboard latency and trace ingestion.
Felix (Design): GA deliverables: 3 dashboard templates (latency, error hotspots, cost spotlight), a mini-gallery UI, and a sampled-state indicator on panels. can deliver mocks in 4 days.
Noor (CS): customers want an "estimated $ / route" badge and CSV export for finance teams. prioritize top-10 routes widget.
Asha (Security): residency & export audit logs are blockers for some enterprise customers. require doc and admin-only controls.
Jared (PM): proposed acceptance criteria for beta -> GA gating: 1) 3 beta customers sign off (enterprise/mid/startup), 2) dashboard med <200ms and p95 <600ms, 3) trace join success >97% for mirrored traffic, 4) per-route cost median error <7%, 5) export config audit logs present.
Mina (Eng): sampling config we plan:
```
tracing:
  default_sample_rate: 0.03
  hot_path_override: 0.95
  retention_days_hosted: 7
  retention_days_dedicated: 30
  throttle_policy:
    enabled: true
    burst_limit: 8000
    fallback: summary_traces
```
Mina (Eng): note: default 3% vs 5% tradeoff — lower cost vs signal; need product decision. per-tenant override for Dedicated only.
Priya (SRE): SLO suggestions: dashboard p50 <180ms, p95 <500ms; ingestion latency p99 <5s; fallback to summary traces within 90s of sustained breach. Rollback if customer-visible error rate increases >2% during canary.
Noor (CS): beta asks: include a short checklist for customers: 1) enable mirror, 2) verify dashboard relevance, 3) validate cost estimates for top-10 routes. We'll provide invite template.
Asha (Security): add KMS integration notes and EU storage disclosure to docs. export sink changes must require admin + be audited.
build-bot: deploy-queue: currently 9 waiting, avg_wait 2.2m. recommend extending canary window.
Jared (PM): action items: Mina -> sampling & throttle behavior doc + cost-estimate POC by Fri. Felix -> gallery mock + sampled-state badge by Thu. Priya -> SLO & rollback automation plan by Mon. Asha -> residency & export audit checklist by Tue. Noor -> beta candidate list + invite copy by Thu. I'll assemble GA checklist and update roadmap.
Mina (Eng): quick follow-up: we should surface "throttled" and "sampled" as explicit states in the cost UI with hovertext explaining impact.
Felix (Design): agree — will mock inline tooltip and small help copy.
Jared (PM): last call: anything else to move into MUST?
Priya (SRE): add alerts for sampling rate drops below expected thresholds during beta.
Noor (CS): ask marketing for a one-pager showing estimated $/route caveats.
Jared (PM): ok thanks team. I'll publish consolidated plan and create tickets. meeting after docs land. :rocket:
